verdict.rationale: The docs show the Query Builder supports WHERE (filter) and GROUP BY clauses over fields (docs-24, docs-32), and that custom span attributes such as user or request context can be added as queryable fields (docs-12, docs-30). However, nothing in the pack explicitly addresses high-cardinality fields or confirms that no pre-aggregation or index definition is needed, which is the heart of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of high-cardinality group-by/filter support, evidence that no indexes or pre-aggregation are required, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
